ARTICLE 2 RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS

2.1 Engagement; Grant of Rights. Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement and during the Term, Dova grants Valeant, on a co-exclusive basis (solely with Dova and its Affiliates), the right to Detail and promote the Product in the Specialty within the Territory and in the Field, and, in accordance with this Agreement’s terms and conditions, to carry out the Valeant Activities and the activities of the institutional account management team (pursuant to and subject to the terms of Section 4.1.5) for the Product in the Territory in the Field. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Dova retains and reserves for Dova and its Affiliates the right to promote the Product in the Territory, including in the Specialty. Other than the rights expressly provided in this Agreement, Valeant shall have no rights concerning the Product; without limiting the foregoing, except as set out in Section 4.1.5, if agreed upon, Valeant shall have no right to, and shall not, perform the Valeant Activities for the Product outside the Specialty, outside the Territory, or for use outside the Field. Valeant's rights and obligations under this Section 2.1 shall be non-transferable, non-assignable, and non-delegable, except to Affiliates of Valeant. Valeant shall not subcontract the Valeant Activities to any Third Party (including any contract sales force), except to Affiliates of Valeant. At Valeant's sole and exclusive option, Valeant or its Affiliates may satisfy, meet or fulfill, in whole or in part, any obligation of Valeant under or pursuant to this Agreement. Valeant guarantees that its Affiliates will perform all actions, agreements and obligations required to be performed by them under this Agreement’s terms and conditions. For clarity, no license rights hereunder are granted to Valeant, and Valeant shall have no rights to sublicense any rights hereunder.

1. General provisions

1.1 This agreement constitutes a framework agreement. Its terms and conditions shall govern every purchase order signed pursuant to this agreement (hereinafter referred to as the "order").

1.2 Where any provision of this agreement conflicts with the order, the order shall take precedence. Matters not specified in the order shall be governed by this agreement. No modification, supplement or waiver shall have effect unless recorded in writing and signed and confirmed by the authorized representatives of the buyers and sellers; otherwise, it shall be invalid.

2. The agreement and order

2.1 Throughout the validity term of this agreement, The buyer shall entrust SHENZHEN YICHANGTAI IMPORT AND EXPORT TRADE CO., LTD or SHENZHEN LEHEYUAN TRADING CO, LTD (hereinafter referred to as the "entrusted party" or "YICHANGTAI" or "LEHEYUAN") to procure from the seller, by means of orders, the products specified in this agreement.

2.2 Within three working days following receipt of an order, the seller shall confirm it. Should the seller determine that the order is unacceptable or requires amendment, the seller should notify entrusted party within two working days after receiving the order. If the seller fails to confirm the order within the required time or fails to notify that it does not accept the order or proposed modifications, the seller shall be deemed to have accepted the order. Upon the seller's acceptance, the order shall become effective, and neither party shall unilaterally cancel it before the two sides agreed .

2.3 Where the seller proposes amendments or declines to accept an order, the seller shall notify entrusted party in writing. The modified order shall take effect only after entrusted party accepts the modifications by written consent.

2.4 Seller's note, only orders issued by the entrusted party at the buyer's entrustment shall have legal force with respect to product delivery and payment.

The penalty shall accrue at the rate of 0.5% for each seven-day period, and any odd period of fewer than seven days should be counted as seven days. Should the Sellers fail to deliver ten weeks later than the shipment time stipulated in the Contract, the Buyers have the right to cancel the contract; notwithstanding such cancellation, the Sellers shall pay the aforesaid penalty to the Buyers without delay, the seller should refund the money received and pay the 30% of the total goods price of the penalty 19. The Arbitration shall be conducted in Beijing, and the Arbitration Committee’s decision shall be final and binding upon both parties; neither party shall resort to a law court or any other authority to appeal for revision of the decision. To activate a Seeded Profile, Bizzingo shall notify a prospective user that the prospective user's Seeded Profile exists on the Network, after which the prospective user is required to: (i) search the Bizzingo database and find its Seeded Profile and (ii) claim that Seeded Profile through the editing or addition of content to it. Upon a user’s completion of the steps described in the immediately preceding sentence, that user shall be considered an "Activated User," and the Network shall designate that user as an Activated User. Method 2. Independently of Method 1, a prospective user may establish its own user profile on the Network. Gfeller will remain on the Company's slate of director nominees, continue serving as directors and stand for election at the 2020 Annual Meeting alongside the four newly-appointed directors.
